summary: Phase 2 ProClinic — tested 11 new backend endpoints (24 pytest cases) + critical frontend flows. Backend 22/24 PASS (91.6%). Two failures both rooted in ONE bug: PUT /api/attendance/{session_id} uses Pydantic `model_dump(exclude_none=False)` and Optional fields default to None — autosave therefore overwrites `appointment_id` (and any other Optional unset field) to None on the existing session. This breaks GET /api/attendance/by-appointment/{aid} after first autosave and makes /finalize unable to mark the appointment as concluido (sess['appointment_id'] is None). Frontend critical Phase 2 wins all verified: login works, clicking an appointment card opens ONLY the detail dialog (data-testid='appointment-detail-dialog') with Paciente/Procedimento/Quando/Sala/Valor/Status and Confirmar/WhatsApp/Cancelar/Excluir/Iniciar atendimento buttons — the previous double-modal bug is GONE; Mensagens page lists queued messages with Evolution-API-pending banner; sidebar shows nav-mensagens link.

critical.issue: Autosave overwrites `appointment_id` (and any other Optional field that the client doesn't send) to None because AttendanceSessionIn has appointment_id Optional[str]=None and the route does `data.model_dump(exclude_none=False)`. Consequences: (1) GET /api/attendance/by-appointment/{aid} returns null right after the first autosave, breaking 'retomar atendimento'; (2) /finalize uses sess.get('appointment_id') to mark the appointment concluido — so the appointment STAYS as 'agendado' even after finalize. Fix: change to `data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` OR exclude immutable identity fields (appointment_id, patient_id) from the update set, OR remove them from AttendanceSessionIn entirely.

minor.issue: Uses appointments.update_one without checking matched_count; if appointment_id is missing (bug above) it silently no-ops. Add logging or return record_id+appointment_status.
Path traversal not validated. A clinic_id check guards via DB lookup, but consider rejecting '..' segments explicitly.

MIME validation is permissive (accepts content_type from client). For an aesthetic clinic that stores patient photos, enforce a whitelist (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf) before put_object.

ui_bugs.issue: Console still warns 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on the new-appointment dialog and detail dialog. A11y regression from Phase 1.

issues: Layout, copy, fields and CTAs (Confirmar/WhatsApp/Cancelar/Excluir/Iniciar atendimento) look polished and on-brand. The badge 'agendado' uses the rose-gold accent — consistent with theme.
Banner 'Integração Evolution API pendente' is clear and well-styled. Empty-vs-populated states both look good.

action_items: HIGH: Fix PUT /api/attendance/{session_id} so autosave does NOT null out appointment_id. Recommended: replace `data.model_dump(exclude_none=False)` with `data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` AND/OR drop appointment_id from AttendanceSessionIn (it shouldn't be mutable via autosave).
After the fix, rerun: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_api.py::TestAttendance — the 2 failing cases (test_update_and_by_appointment, test_finalize_creates_record_and_marks_apt) should both pass.
Whitelist allowed MIME types in POST /api/uploads.
Add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby={undefined}) to Radix DialogContent in NewAppointmentDialog, AppointmentDetailDialog, AttendanceDialog to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AttendanceSessionIn mixes mutable session fields (evolution, observations…) with identity fields (appointment_id, patient_id). Split into AttendanceCreateIn vs AttendanceUpdateIn to avoid this class of accidental-overwrite bug.

Object storage init_storage() uses requests (sync) inside a sync helper called from async routes. Works because put_object is invoked via Starlette's threadpool for sync def, but the @api_router.post('/uploads') handler is async and directly calls put_object → blocks the event loop on a 12MB upload. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.
server.py is now 1380 lines. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/patients.py, routers/agenda.py, routers/attendance.py, routers/storage.py, routers/ai.py, routers/messages.py.
AISummaryIn validation: type uses Literal but errors out with 500 not 422 when invalid (because of FastAPI exception path) — actually FastAPI returns 422; keep an eye on this.
POST /api/messages does not enforce that body is non-empty; allows {body:''} to be queued. Add Field(min_length=1).

rca of the issue:
ROOT CAUSE — server.py update_attendance (~line 1161-1177): `update = data.model_dump(exclude_none=False)` includes ALL Pydantic fields, defaulting Optional unset ones to None. AttendanceSessionIn.appointment_id is Optional[str]=None. The frontend autosave POSTs only the fields it owns (evolution, observations, photos…), so the request body parses with appointment_id=None, and the $set wipes the original appointment_id stored at /start time. Subsequent by-appointment lookups return null and /finalize cannot mark the appointment concluido. REPRO: 1) POST /api/attendance/start {appointment_id: } → returns session with appointment_id populated. 2) PUT /api/attendance/{session_id} with body {patient_id:

, evolution:'x'} → returns session with appointment_id=null. 3) GET /api/attendance/by-appointment/ → null. 4) POST /api/attendance/{session_id}/finalize → returns ok but appointment status remains 'agendado'. MITIGATION: `update = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` OR drop appointment_id from AttendanceSessionIn (it's an identity field, not session content).
